description: This file defines data structures, constants, and function prototypes for reading and parsing Redis protocol replies, including error codes, reply types, and the redisReader API.

methods.name: redisReaderCreateWithFunctions
methods.description: Creates a new redisReader instance with specified reply object functions.

methods.name: redisReaderFree
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for a redisReader instance.

methods.name: redisReaderFeed
methods.description: Feeds data into the redisReader for parsing.

methods.name: redisReaderGetReply
methods.description: Retrieves the parsed reply from the redisReader.
